posts.t:
It's not necessary at all!

I didn't take any courses, and I know how to profit from trading.

RTM has all the pieces of the puzzle, and many of them are even put together here.

The Academy simply has the entire puzzle put together.

Even with that, each student still must put in tons of work, and must overcome their psyche issues in order to benefit.

Those who pay, are those who know I know how the market works, and who
are willing to invest an awful lot of both time and money in learning
it.

They've turned out to be a very intelligent and caring bunch of people,
who're now making deadly accurate trade calls every day of the week. I'd
happily put pending orders at any price they say, without even asking
why!

Nowadays, whenever I make a trade call, I'm told "yes, we discussed that, and have it marked already".

They'll soon make me redundant, and I'm delighted

همهٔ قطعه‌های پازل در RTM هست، و خیلی‌هایشان حتی همین‌جا کنار هم چیده شده‌اند.

آکادمی فقط کل پازل را کنار هم دارد.

کسانی پول می‌دهند که می‌دانند من می‌دانم بازار چطور کار می‌کند، و حاضرند وقت و پول بسیار زیادی برای یاد گرفتنش بگذارند.

این روزها هر وقت کال معاملاتی می‌دهم، به من می‌گویند «بله، همان را بحث کردیم و از قبل علامتش زده‌ایم».
